title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Can I read any of the books here? I can read all of them?  Oh, thank you! I'll be careful! I won't mess them up!

title: Talk 1
original: Ah, sorry, please don't go touching my book. It might bite your hand if you do. No, really, I'm not joking, I'm serious. Look! I even have to tie it shut like this.

title: Talk 2
original: Doctor, do you know where the library is? I asked someone just now, but they were talking too fast. It was hard to understand.

title: Talk 3
original: Skyfire, um, Skyfire, wait for me! Uwwhh, please don't walk so fast... I promise I won't run off halfway this time, I promise!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I like reading, but I like hanging out with everyone too! It makes me so happy when I can be with the people I like. Also, don't be fooled. I'm really good at sporty stuff! Especially climbing trees. I can climb super high!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I got some new inspiration after talking to Miss Eyjafjalla today! She's very well-researched on environmental geology. Thank goodness my group's research wasn't stopped because of my accident. Heheh! If I get results this time, I can reapply to the Institution to resume my studies.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Skyfire is an alumna from my university. She graduated soon after I entered since she skipped a year, but even still, she did look after me... Oh, speaking of! She's also the one who introduced me to Rhodes Island! It's thanks to her I'm receiving treatment here.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Um, I suppose I've been following you around, haven't I? I mean, I feel really at ease when I'm around you, so I just unconsciously... A-Am I annoying you, Doctor? Do you want me to go away?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, this is for you. I found it on the way back, and so many more pretty-looking stones just like it! But, well... that was before I realized I'd gotten separated from the others. Mm? The ore chunk on your desk from before? I put that there too, yes. Did you like it, Doctor?

title: Idle
original: Nnh... mmmmnnh... there! Ah, Doctor! Sorry! Did I wake you up? There was a bug on your head, so I just, um—did it hurt? I can shush it better!

title: Onboard
original: Thank you for helping me move all these books! Just leave them here, please. Oh, my codename is Mint. What's yours? Doctor? Wait, so you're the Doctor? Skyfire was telling me about you!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Wow... incredible! Everyone's so incredible!

title: Promotion 1
original: Are there any rewards for promotion? Can I borrow even more books than before?

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, come sit down here. How is it? The sun feels really nice, right? Eheheh. This is my secret base. I love it here more than anywhere. Don't tell anyone else about it, okay?

title: Added to Squad
original: Got it. Are you coming with us, Doctor?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Wait! You want me as the leader?

title: Depart
original: We're off.

title: Begin Operation
original: Are those our enemies, then?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Mmmm… Whuh? What? Yes, I'm listening!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Yep! Leave it to me.

title: Deployment 1
original: One, two—whoopsie-daisy.

title: Deployment 2
original: Please don't get in our way!

title: In Battle 1
original: Take that!

title: In Battle 2
original: Please calm down a little!

title: In Battle 3
original: I've got you now.

title: In Battle 4
original: Would you like to see some of my magic?

title: 4-star Result
original: Everything went just like you said it would, Doctor! Amazing...!

title: 3-star Result
original: Phew... it's over. We can finally head back now.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: It doesn't look like any more are coming for us... This is fine for now, right?

title: Operation Failure
original: We can't, it's too dangerous... Doctor, you need to get away!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Um, to tell the truth, I'd be alright sleeping in the library too.

title: Tap
original: Yah!

title: Trust Tap
original: Ah! Doctor, would you like to read with me? It's really comfortable sitting here.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Hm... I'm starting to miss my mum and dad. Skyfire has been away from home for so long. Maybe I should ask her how she manages... Oh, Doctor. Will a Messenger visit Rhodes Island today? I have a letter I'd like to post.

title: Greeting
original: So this is where you were, Doctor! Found you.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, here's a book as a present. Happy birthday! Look, I illustrated the cover myself. I'm always gathering minerals, and these ones have been recent favorites of mine. I looked for paints with lusters as close as I could get! And I have the actual rocks to give you too, of course. What do you think, Doctor? Go on, it's all for you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I wish I could participate in more research projects. My instructor and teammates always take such good care of me. They're worried my illness could get worse if I push myself too hard, so they don't let me join them on the surveys... I must get better at Rhodes Island so I can go back and focus on my research.
